draw_order: 32px walls: one complete corner composite OR original cap and face per owning cell
assembly.anchor_rule: Draw position = desired anchor position minus frame anchor. Read source rectangle from frames[name].frame.
assembly.corner_rule: Use Wall_E{edge:02}_I{inner:02}_V{variant} when inner is nonzero. Draw at cell origin minus [8,8]. This is a complete wall with positive 3D returns; omit separate cap, face, cutout and rim passes for that cell. For inner=0 use the original cap/face tiles. Keep original wall-layer depth ordering; split/clip against cell occlusion regions if your renderer paints complete tall sprites independently.
assembly.wall_composite_rule: wall_full_0..3 combine matching cap and face; use these OR separate cap/face frames, not both.
assembly.orientation: Fixed South camera; no sprite rotation.

inner_corner_autotile.eligibility_rule: A diagonal opening contributes an inner corner only when both adjacent cardinal neighbors are wall.

assembly.resource_anchor_rule: North/east/west: 40x88 overlay at owning cap origin minus [4,4]. South: unchanged 32x48 overlay at face origin, or use center anchor [16,24]. Ground resin blobs: 32x32 at ground contact minus [16,24]. UI items: native 32x32 with pure colored resources. Regular resin: 32x32 anchor [16,24], one blob. Big resin: 48x48 anchor [24,36], three clumps.

cave_dressing.placement: Integer pixel scatter; draw origin = placement minus frame anchor. Surface details and water below props/actors. Wall overlays on exposed south faces below black caps. Preserve authored projection.

water_puddles.placement: Decorative floor layer below actors, props and other dressing. Per-frame anchors and native sizes; collision is false.
